scope: Accepted plan section 3.1; source retention does not mean production registration. Existing Agent Chat remains authoritative; no t3 Orchestrator is started.

included.orchestrator_capabilities: orchestrator/tools.ts: enabled existing Provider/model inventory; no secrets, config, login, native discovery sessions or delegation capability claims
included.t3_project_list: project/tools.ts: currently granted PM business project catalog, explicitly not repository projects
included.t3_project_read: project/tools.ts: granted PM project metadata; no directory initialization or arbitrary path
included.t3_thread_list: orchestrator/tools.ts: only explicit grant thread IDs, never global history
included.t3_thread_read: orchestrator/tools.ts: granted persisted Chat history and current generation, bounded offset page
included.t3_thread_launch: project/tools.ts: one idle scoped thread, optional explicit catalog-validated provider/model settings; atomic creation plus settings plus grant plus clientRequestId receipt; no worktree or implicit model execution
included.t3_thread_send: orchestrator/tools.ts: optional explicit selection persisted via existing settings validators/App invalidation and idle revision-CAS before existing submitChat; durable clientRequestId receipt; unknown never redispatched
included.t3_thread_interrupt: orchestrator/tools.ts: exact authorized generation via cancelThreadChat; cancellation is not rollback

pmTools.source: Existing PM agent-tools registry, not an upstream t3 business toolkit
pmTools.selection: Every tool in the current PM-authorized registry; write tools omitted for read-only grants
pmTools.input: {threadId,operationId,arguments}; original tool inputSchema is preserved under arguments
pmTools.authority: callPmTool shared with native bridge; pending_approval retained for protected actions; operationId and argument identity, original receipts and unknown handling preserved
pmTools.approval: Existing PM tools UI; same live PM actor as originating grant plus current delegation scope/full ceiling; revoke denies later approval

orchestrator.reason: No foreign orchestration, workflow, scheduler, secret-request, batch-thread or metadata lifecycle is mounted. The accepted external facade exposes explicit read/create/send/stop using host Chat, not the full upstream toolkit.

project.reason: Upstream repository registration/clone semantics are not PM business project mutations; authorized PM project tools remain available under their own names.

thread.reason: Source retained; no foreign queue, scheduling, transfer, global search, configuration or organization authority is registered. Provider selection for an explicit send uses existing host configuration validation.

attachment.reason: No equivalent scoped signed-upload contract in this accepted external facade; existing Chat attachments remain unchanged.

environment.reason: Environment-wide settings are not equivalent to PM actor-scoped preferences; no authorized equivalent is registered.

previewControls.reason: MCP Apps are isolated producing-item resources, not the source collaborative browser product.

preview.reason: Full collaborative browser automation is explicitly outside plan section 3.1.

device.reason: Device host product is explicitly outside plan section 3.1.

html.reason: General HTML rendering/browser product is not the isolated MCP Apps producing-item contract.

worktree.reason: Existing PM delivery worktree service is not the full upstream general worktree product.

pullRequests.reason: No foreign PR watcher, guides or general worktree/PR product is mounted.

nativeInjection.codex: Existing bound stdio descriptor projection and per-generation authorization retained
nativeInjection.antigravity,grok,fx,acpRegistry: Existing native ACP bridge and live host authority retained
nativeInjection.claude: Only server-bound mcp__SERVER__TOOL callbacks authorized, with active generation/owner/signal checks; arbitrary native permissions remain denied
nativeInjection.muse: Only bound stdio MCP server tool callbacks admitted; protected native writes still not auto-approved; current turn authorization retained
nativeInjection.cursor: Bound stdio MCP clients projected to namespaced SDK custom tools; worker authorizes every execute; native commands still ungranted
nativeInjection.opencode: Source-supported single generation transport retained; PM plus additional integration descriptors remain explicitly unsupported
nativeInjection.pi: Source-supported single generation-owned extension/transport retained; arbitrary multi-server descriptors explicitly unsupported
nativeInjection.omp: Existing newer host PM bridge retained; no matching pinned upstream generic injection implementation; additional descriptors explicitly unsupported

revocationSemantics: Authorization is rechecked at final PM authority checks. Independent Agent SQLite and PM database commits are not claimed to provide cross-store atomic revocation.
